title: "UML"
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    collapse: true
    comment: '#>'
    echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: pkgs
#| include: false
use("nemo", "nemo_uml")
use("tidywigits", "WIGITS_TOOLS")
use("purrr", "map_chr")
use("knitr", "asis_output")
```

```{r}
#| label: uml
x <- sort(c(
  map_chr(WIGITS_TOOLS, "classname"),
  "Config",
  "Tool",
  "Wigits",
  "Workflow"
))
# hand it over directly to knitr for rendering, cat somehow doesn't work any more
asis_output(nemo_uml(
  classes = x,
  pkg = "tidywigits"
))
```
